title: Import of a documented AI-hallucinated (slopsquatting) package name
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin ai-fingerprint observed rules
description:
Detects an `import`/`from...import` statement naming a specific, independently-documented package name that LLM coding assistants are known to hallucinate (e.g. huggingface_cli -- the real package is huggingface_hub). Curated seed list, not a heuristic: each entry traces to a cited, confirmed-nonexistent-at-discovery package. A hit means the code names a package with no legitimate reason to exist, which is exactly the shape of a supply-chain compromise (slopsquatting: an attacker registers the invented name and ships malware to whoever installs it). Per-hit confidence is high without requiring co-occurrence, same reasoning as ai_provenance -- a literal match against a definitively-known-fake name is near-zero-FP by construction.

Aggregated from 1 fingerprint hit(s) across 1 file(s). Sample paths: apps/foo/corge.py.
